title.native: 青の祓魔師 島根啓明結社篇

description:
At True Cross Academy, Rin Okumura unknowingly comes across the first signs that something is amiss; ordinary people have been gaining the ability to perceive the invisible creatures that roam the human realm, Assiah. While Rin sees this as an opportunity to make a new friend, his twin brother, Yukio, is more burdened than ever. Swamped with his education, exorcist duties, and teaching position, Yukio has remained silent about his awakened powers, unable to understand their scale or significance.
While Rin and his friends prepare for the annual Exorcist Certification Exam, the True Cross Order has uncovered the first artificial gate to the demonic realm of Gehenna. Witnessing its size and the advanced technology that made it possible, the exorcists realize they are now dealing with the Illuminati, an extremely wealthy and powerful organization. Moreover, the inscrutable Illuminati have planted three spies in the True Cross Order—and one may be hiding among the aspiring exorcists sworn to protect mankind from the demonic threat.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

node.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

The fifteen-year-old protagonist of the story, Rin is the son of [Satan](https://anilist.co/character/48449) born from a human woman and is the inheritor of Satan's powers. His powers were sealed at birth into the demon-slaying blade Kurikara, or Koumaken, by [Mephisto Pheles](https://anilist.co/character/30432), allowing him to live a normal human life for about 15 years.

Shura Kirigakure is a Knight and an Upper-First Class Exorcist. Having trained under the guidance of Shirou Fujimoto, she officially works as an inspector for the Vatican, but has infiltrated True Cross Academy, first as a student under the name Yamada, and later as a teacher for the Exwires. She is currently the mentor of Rin Okumura.

name.native: メフィスト・フェレス

node.description:
__Height:__ 195 cm (6'5") 

Pheles is the Chairman of True Cross Academy and also an Exorcist. After Fujimoto's death Pheles was ordered to kill Rin, however he accepted Rin's proposal in becoming an Exorcist and entered him into True Cross Academy. It has been heavily implied that he is the son of Satan along with his brother, the Earth King, Amaimon. He possesses the unique and peculiar ability of transforming into a small dog after counting down from three in German. How powerful he is has not been shown but he has mentioned that he is an honorary knight, the position two ranks below Paladin. He has been shown responsible for allowing several higher class demons onto campus. His name is an obvious pun on the word Mephistopheles, which is name for the another infamous devil, similar to his father Satan.

A two-tailed cat demon (nekomata).  Formerly Fujimoto's familiar but is now Rin's familiar.  Kuro is a Cat Sith who was once worshipped as a protective deity for silkworms.  He usually takes the appearance of a kitten, but he can reach an enormous size at will.

__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") 

Yukio is Rin Okumura's twin and younger brother and Shiro Fujimoto's adopted son. He is a Middle First Class Exorcist who has started his training to become an Exorcist at seven by his father suggestion and, since then, gained the titles of Dragoon and Doctor at only fourteen, becoming the youngest Exorcist in the True Cross Order history. Yukio is also the youngest teacher of the True Cross' Exorcist Cram School, at which he teaches pharmacology. Before he was born, he has had a weak body that couldn't bear the power of the blue flames, causing the power of Satan to be fully inherited by Rin. He is seen as an ​example and prodigy by the ones who live together with him and is friends with Shiemi Moriyama, who calls him Yuki-chan.

__Height:__ 177 cm (5'8")

Shirou Fujimoto was [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/24482/Okumura-Rin) and [Yukio](https://anilist.co/character/24734/Okumura-Yukio)'s guardian and was also considered to be one of the most powerful Exorcists in the world. He was thought to be the only man in the world that was able to sustain possession by [Satan](https://anilist.co/character/48449/Satan) himself and thus Satan was constantly after his body. Fujimoto had a familiar sith cat demon, which he called [Kuro](https://anilist.co/character/43187/Kuro), that Rin had inherited. He was a confirmed Aria, Dragoon and tamer and could possibly have been a Knight and a Docter as two of those who have studied under him have become these. He was said to be the strongest exorcist on the planet and was the only one to gain the rank of Paladin, the highest rank of the exorcists.

__Height:__ 165 cm (5'4")    

Slightly allergic to pollen. Shiemi is [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/24482/Okumura-Rin)'s classmate and friend. Before she met Rin, Shiemi tended her grandmother's garden while her mother ran an Exorcist only shop inside True Cross Academy. During her encounter with Rin and [Yukio](https://anilist.co/character/24734/Okumura-Yukio), they were able to discover that Shiemi was having her life force leached out by a Demon. After Yukio exorcised the demon, Shiemi finally decided to become an Exorcist and started to attend class. It was later revealed that Shiemi had talent in becoming a Tamer, as she was able to summon a Greenman Spirit during class. It is apparently a rare talent to possess amongst the Exorcists, where there are only a few who can control demons and fight.

__Height:__ 164 cm

Izumo Kamiki is a top student at the Exorcism Cram School of True Cross Academy who comes from a long line of shrine maidens.

__Height:__ 181 cm

He is [Rin's](https://anilist.co/character/24482/Okumura-Rin) rival and the prodigy in the class. He was the child of the Cursed Temple which was destroyed by [Satan](https://anilist.co/character/48449/Satan) 16 years ago. Bon takes everything seriously and is trying his hardest in order to become an Exorcist powerful enough so he could one day defeat Satan ( a goal he claims Rin stole from him) and rebuild his Temple. Currently Bon is trying to acquire the title of Meister in both Aria (a person who recites holy texts to kill certain demons) and Dragoon (a person who fights with heavy artillery). He is currently an Exwire. He is good at memorization, cleaning and Zen meditation.

__Height:__ 176 cm

Renzou is a very carefree character, yet he has a fear of many things, mainly bugs. He's very loyal to Bon, his childhood friend. They grew up together along with Konekomaru in Kyoto. He is also has a big obsession with women. Plans to become a Meister in Aria He is the 5th and youngest son of his family, and tells Konekomaru he's glad of this because it means he has less responsibilities. His older brother Juuzou says he's the pervert out of the brothers. Renzou is a carefree character and was the first person to actually befriend Rin since the revealing of the blue flames, which shows Renzou is the friendly-type. He is also afraid of bugs, yet he is known as the pervert out of the Shima brothers.

Nii-chan is Shiemi Moriyama's Familiar that she summons during the demonstration after Izumo Kamiki summoned two spirit foxes. It is a baby Greenman spirit that takes a liking to Shiemi often sitting on top of her head. Nii-chan aids Shiemi by producing plant from it's body such as aloe and sprouts tree branches as barriers. Nii-chan appears protective of Shiemi as he shields her from the falling debris during a mission in the amusement park with tree barriers. Possibly because it's still an infant, it does not think of Shiemi or the humans as a threat. It speaks by saying the phrase "Nii!"

__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10") 

He is an Arc Knight and an Exorcist of the True Cross Order.

~!He is the traveling companion and right-hand man of Arthur A. Angel, which makes him ranked second in the True Cross Order.!~

~!He reveals that he doesn't experience empathy towards people, and has always lacked this ability since he was born!~

__Height:__ 155 cm

Konekomaru Miwa hails from Kyoto along with Ryuji Suguro and Renzo Shima and is an Exwire of the True Cross Order, a student of the Exorcist Cram School, and the surviving head of the Miwa family.

__Height:__ 163 cm

Takara is a quiet, mysterious character. He is also somewhat of a ventriloquist. He hasn't talked much, and when he does, it's usually through ventriloquism. He is short, only slightly taller than Konekomaru, and wears the typical True Cross Academy uniform. Has yet to be shown opening his eyes and is always seen with his rabbit puppet. Not much is known about him he also did not contribute to the group effort in the Exwire exam. However, when he speaks with his rabbit puppet, the voice and tone is usually very rude.

name.native: アーサー・オーギュスト・エンジェル

node.description:
The newly appointed Paladin. He was ordered by the Grigori to to interrogate Mephisto and captured Rin as evidence. According to Shura he's a saint on the outside and a devil inside. Uses the demon sword Caliburn.

Not much is known about Arthur so far, except that he is extremely loyal to the True Cross Order. He follows the orders of his superiors without questioning them at all, even attempting to kill people when they interfere with his work. He believes that anything related to Satan must be destroyed, as it could only cause harm to let them live. Arthur also seems to be slightly sadistic, as he stabbed Rin completely through the leg to immobilize him during Rin's trial, while remarking that the wound would heal soon enough. According to Shura, he is a saint on the outside and a devil on the inside, hinting that he may have a malicious personality.

Kinzou is the fourth son of the Shima family, Renzou's older brother. He seems to be a pretty simple guy who is ruled by his emotions, kicking his little brother in the head as a greeting and paying no attention to the conversation at breakfast, preferring to stuff his face.
Ryuuji Suguro's father. Survivor of the Blue Night, when scores of clergymen were massacred by Satan. Known as the "Priest of the Cursed Temple."  (source: BlueExorcist.com)

Juuzou is the 2nd son of the Shima family, his younger brothers include Kinzou and Renzou. As the 2nd son, he has more responsibilities than his younger brothers. Since the 1st son of the Shima family was killed in the Blue Night incident 16 years ago, Juuzou is the successor of the Shima family. He and Houjou Mamushi are childhood friends and attended the Exorcist cramschool together.

The King of Light and the strongest of the Eight Demon Kings. He is also the Commander-in-Chief of the Illuminati.

(Source: Ao no Exorcist Wiki)
Noriko is Izumo's best friend but quits the cram school because she did not understand the classes and she was failing.
She is an Exorcist at the Kyoto Branch of the True Cross Order and Uwabami Houjou's daughter. Her sisters are Mamushi and Ao Houjou.
Miketsu, or simply Mike, is a Byakko and Eighth in rank amongst his peers. He is Izumo Kamiki's familiar, having previously served her mother, Tamamo Kamiki.
is an Upper First Class Exorcist, and the Chief of the True Cross Order's Kyoto Branch Office. He is the father of Juuzou, Kinzou and Renzou Shima, as well as the overall head of the Shima family.

Upper second-class exorcist of the Order, First Year Magic Circles and Seals instructor at the True Cross Academy, and Warden of the Deep Keep.
~! He has betrayed the Order as he helped steal the Left Eye of the Impure King, which used to be in the Deep Keep.!~ ~! He is a Demon Eater and has swallowed Karura the Phoenix, which has given him impressive regeneration skills. Now, he answers to the Illuminati secret society.!~
A high-ranking member of the Illuminati and captain of Phosphorus, Lucifer's bodyguards. Also the daughter of Saburota Todo.
Ukemochi or simply Uke, is a Byakko and Izumo Kamiki's familiar. He previously served her mother, Tamamo Kamiki.
Sei Godaiin is a student who attends True Cross Academy.
